patterns.name: Hold before you send
patterns.mechanic: press and hold send for three seconds while the urgent note pulses
patterns.learns: An urgent request is the moment to slow down, not speed up.

patterns.name: Call back on a number you trust
patterns.mechanic: choose which phone number to dial from the email, the signature or your own directory
patterns.learns: Check a request through a channel you already had, never one the request gives you.

patterns.name: Revoke on the last day
patterns.mechanic: tap leaver badges as they drift towards the door before they cross it
patterns.learns: Remove access on the day a person leaves, every time.

patterns.name: How sure are you?
patterns.mechanic: set a confidence dial for each assistant answer, then see which were true
patterns.learns: A fluent answer is not a checked answer. Match your trust to the evidence.

patterns.name: Does the change match the ticket?
patterns.mechanic: tap the line in the deployed change that the approved ticket never mentioned
patterns.learns: Compare what was deployed with what was approved, line by line.

patterns.name: How far does it spread?
patterns.mechanic: drag the sharing scope and watch ripples reach more rings of people
patterns.learns: Share personal data with the smallest group that needs it.
